provider: Liberty Group Limited (part of Standard Bank Group)
about: Offers clients access to a world-class investment from a minimum single premium of R150,000, designed for an investment horizon of at least 5 years. Offers 'pay-on-delivery' investing - clients only pay setup costs if the Target Return on the Liberty Capped Tracker portfolio is achieved. Requires clients to allocate a specified portion of investment to the Liberty Capped Tracker portfolio, with the remainder invested across a range of portfolios. Available as an Endowment (with minimum death benefit) or Sinking Fund (no death benefit, ideal for companies) - choice is made at quote stage and cannot be changed after inception.

key_features.description: No setup costs (including initial advice fees) unless Target Return on Capped Tracker is achieved.
Can be split into a bundle of up to 10 policies, each with different lives assured/beneficiaries/portfolios, for flexibility.

After the first year, clients can access funds via an advance or full surrender of an underlying policy (on the portion not allocated to the Liberty Capped Tracker); no early termination charges on the non-capped portion.
Regular contributions can be invested alongside the lump sum, with an ACI of 0%-20% p.a.

eligibility.life_assured: Only a natural person can be a life assured under the Endowment option.

premiums.payment_method: Money receipted via M65 only; no direct debits for lump sums.

allocation_amount.target: At least 100% allocation of initial single premium at standard 3% (excl. VAT) initial advisory fee.
allocation_amount.formula_note: Allocated amount = Initial consideration - agreed IAF (incl. VAT) + standard advice cost enhancement (3.45%) + contribution enhancement.

growth_sharing.description: Clients invest 60% (higher Target Return) or 40% (lower Target Return) of the initial consideration into the Liberty Capped Tracker portfolio.
growth_sharing.lower_target_return: Starts Growth Sharing earlier than the normal Target Return portfolio (~7% per FAQ section on the Evolve range).
growth_sharing.after_3_years: All Growth Sharing ends; money in Capped Tracker portfolio switches to Top 40 Tracker Portfolio; clients receive full ALSI Top 40 return (incl. dividends).

endowment.formula: Higher of: (1) Investment Value on date of notification of death plus investment enhancement, or (2) total contributions paid less advances taken and advisory fees paid after 5th plan anniversary.
endowment.notes: Payable only on death of last surviving life assured; reduced by initial/ongoing advice fees deducted after 5th policy anniversary; guaranteed maturity value does not apply.

portfolio_charges.portfolio: Liberty Single Manager Risk Profiled Portfolios

fees.ongoing_advice_fee: 0% - 0.5% (excl. VAT); only available after 5th policy anniversary for endowments/sinking funds.
fees.renewal_advice_fee: Up to 5% (excl. VAT), agreed at/after 5 years for new advisers, every 5 years thereafter.
fees.early_termination_charge: Does not apply, although unit price adjusted for outstanding Growth Sharing Deduction within first 3 years.

guarantees.type: Return of contribution guarantee (C-type) available on select portfolios.
guarantees.guarantee_date: 5th policy anniversary and every 5 years thereafter.
guarantees.capped_tracker_with_guarantee: Within first 3 years, clients can switch to another guaranteed portfolio (subject to Growth Sharing Deduction) or a non-guaranteed portfolio (subject to Growth Sharing Deduction). At end of 3 years, guaranteed Capped Tracker automatically transfers to Liberty Top 40 Tracker with guarantee.

portfolio_rules.mandatory_capped_tracker: One of the portfolios must be the Liberty Capped Tracker in the first 3 years.
portfolio_rules.guaranteed_portfolio_limit: Total initial considerations above R10,000,000 into guaranteed portfolios require a special quote.

joint_lives: Endowment: max 5 lives assured per policy. Sinking Fund: not applicable.

ownership.allowed_owners: Individuals, trusts, companies; one owner per bundle (all policies in bundle must share the same owner type).

cessions.first_3_years: Collateral cessions available per underlying policy; absolute cessions not available.
cessions.thereafter: Absolute and collateral cessions available per policy; absolutely ceded policy removed from bundle.

surrenders_advances.capped_tracker_first_3_years: No advance allowed; only access via full surrender (subject to Growth Sharing Deduction).
surrenders_advances.choice_portfolios: Advance allowed up to 90% of investment value of this portion at any time; full surrender allowed with no Growth Sharing Deduction on this portion.
surrenders_advances.legislative_limit_first_5_years: One advance and one surrender permitted; sum may not exceed premiums invested plus 5% p.a. compound interest.

taxation.note: Subject to four-fund tax on investment growth. Income tax: 30% (individuals)/28% (companies)/0% (tax-exempt). CGT: 12% (individuals)/22.4% (companies)/0% (tax-exempt). Dividends withholding tax: 20% (individuals)/0% (companies)/0% (tax-exempt).

policy_term: Open-ended after the legislative restriction term of 5 years.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the lower and higher Target Return Capped Tracker portfolios?
faqs.answer: A lower Target Return means the client needs to invest less in the Capped Tracker portfolio (40% vs 60%) and may start sharing growth with Liberty sooner, but this does not mean the client shares more growth overall since they invest more in their choice of portfolios.

faqs.question: Can I mix Higher and Lower Capped Tracker Portfolios within a bundle?
faqs.answer: No - the Capped Trackers are designed to work across policies in a bundle and cannot be mixed within the same bundle.
